summary: Replace Debian question flow with a Nex setup wizard and per-NIC IPv4/VLAN configuration. API impact: none; standalone local installer only.

guide.reason: New GUI workflow, network settings applied on first boot, interface naming, supported disk selection and recovery require operator instructions.

api.reason: Boot wizard writes private local settings consumed by native installation and target configuration; no client API, Controller operation, Core agent command or result contract exists in this flow.

state.reason: Per-NIC IPv4/VLAN configuration is written to the installed host itself; the Controller observes it through inventory and stores nothing of its own.
state.record: /etc/network/interfaces on the installed host, written by the installer; the agent reports the resulting NICs, bridge and addresses in inventory, and the Controller keeps no copy.

verification.method: Actual BIOS ISO native GTK walkthrough with two NICs, invalid input and disk confirmation, disposable installation and root login/network observation; final native GUI regression, source/compiled checks and documentation checks. Exact artifact separation and untested limits are recorded.
